name: java-spring
stack_notes: Prefer explicit workflow state machines for multi-step processes
Prefer dependency injection and clear boundaries
preferred_patterns: State machine: enum State + transition(event) function + explicit handlers
Event-driven flow: publish event -> idempotent consumer updates state
Avoid God services; prefer composition and small focused services
Use interfaces at boundaries; inject dependencies
allowed_exceptions: Timeouts used for external calls via proper client configs (e.g., HTTP client timeouts) are allowed.
Retries must be bounded with backoff and state persisted if workflow spans requests.
reviewer_quality_gates: Stateful workflows must have explicit states/transitions
Behavior changes must include tests (unit preferred)
